notes.title: "Our Battle Has Just Begun! episode 2" will be available from March 3rd.
notes.notes:
"Our Battle Has Just Begun! episode 2" will be available from March 3rd.
This new country that awaits you is the forest country of Roseail, land of elves and beastmen!

Enjoy the second part of this comical and slightly serious story about an average guy who ends up becoming a Hero.
Feel free to start from either Episode 1 or 2!

To commemorate the release, we will also be holding an ”episode 1” sale for a limited time of 7 days from the date of delivery.
In addition, there is also a great bundle version!
